title: SWOLF Improvement Trend
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=myswimpro:session swolf_score=* stroke_type=*
| timechart span=1w avg(swolf_score) as avg_swolf, min(swolf_score) as best_swolf by stroke_type
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends weekly average and best MySwimPro SWOLF scores by stroke type.
value: SWOLF combines stroke count and time; trending it shows efficiency gains better than distance alone.
implementation: Export MySwimPro sessions with `swolf_score` and `stroke_type`, then review weekly averages after each block.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of SWOLF by stroke and week.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks whether your swim efficiency is getting better week by week.
